When your blood moves like that, it struggles to reach the places that depend on it. And little by little, that's what leaves you stuck with the very thing you've been trying to fix.

I beat my meat every single day for 38 years. Sometimes even twice.

And I am going to tell you exactly what it did to my body and my marriage by the time I turned 52, because I think a lot of men reading this are doing the same thing right now and have no idea what is coming.

I'm 52. Married 31 years. Two kids, both grown and out of the house.

I started beating my meat when I was 14, like every guy I know. I never stopped. I never thought to stop. Nobody ever told me there was a reason to stop.

Every man I have ever talked to does it. Doctors say it's normal. Magazines say it's healthy.
